# At-Home Nail Care Disruption

The post-pandemic growth of DIY gel and press-on systems that lets consumers
replicate a salon-quality **nail** manicure at home, compressing demand at the
low end of professional salon services.

## The driver

Busy lifestyles, cost savings, and salon-grade product availability. Lockdowns
removed salon access and seeded a habit that persisted. Brands responded with
starter kits and at-home gel systems — see [[Press-On Nails Market]].

## The archetype

[[Olive and June]] is the reference case: salon-founder origin, online DTC,
then mass retail. It reshaped the low end of [[Nail Care Market Segmentation]].

> [!gap] No quantified estimate found for how much basic-manicure salon volume
> has migrated to at-home care.
